name: Perazine
summary: Perazine (Taxilan) is a moderate-potency typical antipsychotic of the phenothiazine class. It is quite similar to chlorpromazine, and acts as a dopamine antagonist. It was very popular in West-Germany. A 2014 systematic review compared it with other antipsychotic drugs:

pharmacology.text: It is quite similar to chlorpromazine, and acts as a dopamine antagonist.

uses.en: It was used to treat schizophrenia and other psychoses, and for agitation.
uses.zh: 它曾用於治療精神分裂症與其他精神病症狀，以及躁動不安。
uses.zhHans: 它曾用于治疗精神分裂症与其他精神病症状，以及躁动不安。

sideEffects.en: Like other older antipsychotics it commonly causes stiffness, tremor and restlessness, along with drowsiness and dizziness on standing. Long-term use can cause tardive dyskinesia, which is lasting involuntary movements, and there is a rare risk of a severe reaction with fever and muscle rigidity.
sideEffects.zh: 與其他舊式抗精神病藥一樣，它常造成肌肉僵硬、顫抖與躁動不安，並伴隨嗜睡與站起時頭暈。長期使用可能導致遲發性運動障礙，也就是持久的不自主動作，另有罕見但嚴重的反應風險，會出現發燒與肌肉僵硬。
sideEffects.zhHans: 与其他旧式抗精神病药一样，它常造成肌肉僵硬、颤抖与躁动不安，并伴随嗜睡与站起时头晕。长期使用可能导致迟发性运动障碍，也就是持久的不自主动作，另有罕见但严重的反应风险，会出现发烧与肌肉僵硬。

fact.en: It is a phenothiazine close to chlorpromazine and was for years one of the most used antipsychotics in Germany and Poland.
fact.zh: 它屬於吩噻嗪類，與氯普麻相近，多年來是德國與波蘭最常使用的抗精神病藥之一。
fact.zhHans: 它属于吩噻嗪类，与氯普麻相近，多年来是德国与波兰最常使用的抗精神病药之一。
